bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; appropriating money for the Center of American Indian and Minority Health.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATIONS; CENTER OF AMERICAN INDIAN AND MINORITY HEALTH. +]

[+$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Board of Regents of the University of Minnesota to support the Center of American Indian and Minority Health at the University of Minnesota Medical School, Duluth campus. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; appropriating money for the Center of American Indian and Minority Health.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATIONS; CENTER OF AMERICAN INDIAN AND MINORITY HEALTH.

$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the Board of Regents of the University of Minnesota to support the Center of American Indian and Minority Health at the University of Minnesota Medical School, Duluth campus.
additions: APPROPRIATIONS; CENTER OF AMERICAN INDIAN AND MINORITY HEALTH.
